labelRules: v1 (LLM-labelled, owner-reviewed 2026-10-10). Ask = wants knowledge/explanation in prose: how/why/what-does-X-mean, how-to, general capability questions without a concrete object ('Kannst du Mitarbeiter anlegen?', 'Was kannst du alles?'), imperative requests to explain ('Erkläre mir den Periodenabschluss'). Do = wants the system to act now on concrete data: show/list/open/navigate/create/change/delete/check, incl. questions about concrete data ('Welche Mitarbeiter sind morgen frei?', 'Was steht morgen im Dienstplan?'), indirect requests ('Kannst du für Müller einen Vertrag anlegen?'), verbless/short messages ('Müller in Gruppe Bern', 'verträge'), polite/desire forms. Other = greeting, thanks, praise, smalltalk, farewell, questions about the assistant's identity, and anything off-topic even in question or imperative form. A concrete object/name/date/data makes the same sentence frame Do; general knowledge about the app or labour-planning concepts is Ask. Ask items avoid personal names. Bare confirmations ('ja', 'mach das') are excluded (state-dependent, handled by AffirmationDetector/DeclineDetector). pairId links an Ask and a Do member (same topic, one per locale); templateId groups translations/paraphrases and must stay on one side of any split. Only the 4 core locales de/en/fr/it carry volume; the other 8 locales are small natural-language probes. 'subkind' keeps the original kind of pair members.
